history_section.content_one: <0>GINORL GROUP</0> was established in 2004, focusing on building electrical safety by providing complete power distribution solutions and adapting products to meet research and development, production, sales, and electrical services, including electrical cabinets, wires, cables, and other products. <2>GINORL GROUP</2> has continuously built cooperative and stable relationships with large-scale projects, including government projects, residential technologies, and large commercial projects such as power plants, wind power projects, electronics systems, industrial construction, data, communication, new energy, and transportation. The company adheres to the core policy of <4>"Customer Centric"</4> and persists in researching and developing products according to customer needs. The company's technology research and development center uses a national laboratory and has various certificates such as TISI,MIT, TIS, and CB. The company has received the <6>ISO 9001:2015</6> quality management system certification. We are committed to providing high-quality products and good services, creating continuous growth and development of the organization in the new era, to ensure customers feel confident, safe, and comfortable with the brand.
history_section.content_two: <0>"CT ELECTRIC"</0> is a brand suitable for all environments in various areas. It is versatile, supporting solar energy, UPS, and wiring systems. We develop production, sales, and services to provide customers with a good experience and professional service. <2>CT ELECTRIC</2> has been recognized by customers in various regions for "Safe use of electricity, electrical equipment".

mascot_meaning_section.content: Qiaoxi is the CT brand mascot that represents safety, speed, cheerful service, and care for the environment. Its leaf-shaped green body communicates freshness and positive energy, while the safety goggles, lightning eyes, white CT shirt, and yellow cape reflect confidence in electrical protection.

This leads to continuous organizational development and greater social and environmental responsibility.

intro.content:
As Ginorl Group CT Electrification Co., Ltd. 
is a manufacturer and distributor of electrical equipment, the company has 
obtained permission to build a standardized factory to become a leader in electrical equipment.

iso.content:
ISO: 9001:2015 
is an international standard for quality management systems. In order to obtain ISO: 9001 certification, the company must comply 
with the requirements specified in the ISO: 9001:2015 standard.

tis.content:
TIS is a standard used to determine the quality 
and production process in Thailand to comply with various regulations specified. Generally, 
there are 2 types: mandatory standards which 
are required before selling domestically, 
and non-mandatory standards.

target.content:
Ginorl Group CT Electrification Co., Ltd. 
aims to obtain various product standard certifications, 
regardless of whether those standards are mandatory 
before sale or not, to ensure that customers have full 
confidence in the company's CT brand products.

quality.content:
Maintaining quality, whether it is quality in terms of 
processes or the quality of the products themselves, 
the company strives to the best of its ability 
to consistently maintain such quality in accordance 
with the standards on a regular basis.

timeline.title: From CT Electric (Thailand) to a nationwide electrical equipment manufacturer.
timeline.subtitle: Ginor Group CT Electrification Co., Ltd. has grown with Thailand's electrical industry for 22 years, focusing on quality, safety, and dependable service.

items.title: Company Founded
items.text: Formerly CT Electric (Thailand), the company began as a manufacturer of electrical equipment including consumer breaker panels, relay products, and related electrical solutions.

items.title: Quality Certification
items.text: CT products received quality certification from electrical organizations for assembled consumer panels and circuit breakers, supporting the development of Thailand's electrical industry.

items.title: Samut Sakhon Factory Investment
items.text: In April 2011, the company invested nearly 40 million baht to build a factory in Samut Sakhon province. The factory officially opened in May 2012 and brought new electrical technologies from abroad into Thailand.

items.title: 22 Years in Thailand
items.text: Today, CT products are available through thousands of distribution points nationwide. The company continues to develop safer, higher-quality electrical products to meet customer needs.

intro.title: 5 Production Centers
intro.subtitle: As a domestic manufacturer, we are able to provide fast customer service.

centers.title: Sheet Metal Manufacturing Center
centers.detail: A sheet metal production center for electrical cabinets, electrical boxes, and custom parts, supporting production according to customer requirements.

centers.title: Injection Molding Manufacturing Center
centers.detail: Supports plastic injection molding for electrical components with quality control and consistent part standards.

centers.title: Cable Manufacturing Center
centers.detail: Produces wires and cables for projects, industrial applications, and electrical distribution systems.

centers.title: Industrial Pipe Manufacturing Center
centers.detail: Produces industrial pipes and wiring system accessories for installations that require strength and high standards.

centers.title: Transformer Manufacturing Center
centers.detail: Supports the production and assembly of transformers for power systems, projects, and energy organizations.

items.title: Manufacturing

items.title: Inspection

items.title: Assembly and Packaging
items.description: Assembly and packaging are managed carefully so products remain complete, traceable, and ready for use.

items.description: Product stock is organized and managed systematically to support distribution readiness and order fulfillment.

items.description: Transportation is organized to support reliable domestic delivery and product handling from warehouse to destination.
